snippet.title: Lunchbreak Tactics | QC Skins Trailer
snippet.description:
Lunchbreak Tactics is a no-timer strategic auto-battler card game set in a chaotic supermarket backstore. Draft cards, build absurd synergies, and min-max your squad, then battle other players asynchronously. Easy to pick up, with near-infinite combo variety for high replayability. Quick runs.

Play the demo for free on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4005910/Lunchbreak_Tactics_Demo/
